global: Air control cut league-wide: steering during jumps and dashes drops 90% -> 75% for most heroes, with the biggest fliers hit harder (Kallari 100% -> 90%, Eden 100% -> 85%, Mourn 90% -> 80%).
Default camera lag disabled for both ranged and melee — aiming tracks the camera immediately.

A wide hero-balance pass: 30 heroes touched, headlined by real Rampage nerfs, a Kallari across-the-board trim, an Adele damage-profile shift, and offlane bruiser buffs (Terra, Narbash, Riktor, Steel).
Eternals get their first tuning wave since the 1.16 additions: Weald's execute missiles slow down, Vesh's Lich moves to level breakpoints, Satariel's gamble costs more health per stack.
27 item changes, mostly fighter/tank stat bumps; Astral Catalyst's ultimate refund is soft-reworked to pay on kills and assists instead of any takedown.
items: Brimstone: Health 250 -> 200; cost 1200 -> 1000; Blaze damage 12 -> 10; recipe now Vitality Beads + 650g.
Deathstalker: Physical power 45 -> 50; recipe now Honed Kris + Sai + Sabre + 400g.

Astral Catalyst: Soft rework — Ravenous ultimate cooldown refund 20% on takedown -> 25% on hero kill / 15% on assist; no longer triggers on suicide (bugfix).

Fire Blossom: Cost 2900 -> 3000; Heatwave bonus health scaling 0.7% -> 1%; Firestorm damage ramp 6.25-50% -> 5-40%; recipe now Brimstone + Steel Mail + Vitality Beads + 650g.
Giant's Ring: Gigantism damage reduction 5% -> 8%; hero size 15% -> 20%.

eternals.summary: The first tuning wave since 1.16 added four Eternals: no new faces, nine touched. Weald's execute missiles slow down, Vesh's sustain minors get cooldowns and breakpoints, Krix's minor row is broadly kinder, and Satariel's takedown gamble costs more health per stack.

changes.name: Weald
changes.change: Major: +1 missile per 30% bonus attack speed (was 25%), per-hero cooldown 8s -> 10s; missiles now travel through walls (QoL) and the scaling bugfix lands. Minors: Forage gold 4 -> 3, Dryad's Boon on-hit refund 0.2s -> 0.15s, Wind-Rider becomes 20% +1% per level bonus attack speed.
changes.meaning: The execute Eternal stays an execute but fires less often and demands more attack speed to grow. The wall-piercing QoL is real — the missiles stopped whiffing on terrain — so this is a number trim on a more reliable weapon.

changes.name: Thraex
changes.change: Savage Strikes bugfix: level-1 damage corrected to 1.5 (was dealing the displayed 2).
changes.meaning: A truth-in-advertising fix that plays as a small early nerf for anyone running the minor.

changes.name: Krix
changes.change: Adaptive Plating max stacks 8 -> 10, Growing Threat activates at 16 minutes (was 18), Inescapable slow 20% -> 25% (duration 2s -> 1.75s), Terror tower damage reduction 20% -> 25%, Festering Wounds 2s -> 3s, Predator movement 3% -> 4%; Voracity gold 3 -> 2 and Cannibalism takedown health 35 -> 30.
changes.meaning: Six minors up, two down — the tank tree gets broadly kinder while the economy picks pay slightly less. Krix loadouts have more real choices now.

changes.name: Knell
changes.change: Major bugfix: now stacks correctly with multi-hit abilities. Patina shield 30 -> 35 with cooldown 12s -> 10s, Resonant Repair adds 20 tenacity for 4s on immobilize; Peal ultimate haste 25 -> 15, Fracture per-level damage 0.3% -> 0.2%.
changes.meaning: The major finally works on multi-hit kits — a real buff for them — while the two loudest minors get trimmed to pay for it.

changes.name: Xyris
changes.change: Cold Hearted slow per stack 2% -> 3%, max stacks 5 -> 4.
changes.meaning: Same 12% ceiling in fewer hits — the slow arrives faster but caps a point higher than before only briefly. Better for burst appliers, unchanged for sustained ones.

changes.name: Vesh
changes.change: Lich magical lifesteal restructured: 8% +0.5% per level -> 5/8/12/16% at levels 1/6/11/16. Phylactery duration 3s -> 4s but gains a 20s cooldown. Millenia ultimate damage per minute 1% -> 0.75%.
changes.meaning: The sustain tree pays: Lich is weaker until level 11 and only catches up at 16, and Phylactery stops being an every-fight shield. Mage sustain through Vesh is a late-game promise now.

changes.name: Pilow
changes.change: Harmonic Currents heal/mana now ticks over 3s instead of arriving at once (soft rework); Neurotoxin damage taken per stack 2% -> 1.5%.
changes.meaning: The new defensive Eternal's burst-heal minor becomes a regen minor, and its damage-amp option softens — 1.16's most comfortable support pick gets its edges filed.

changes.name: Azai
changes.change: Sacrifice: missing-mana regen on ability hit 2.5% -> 3.5%, hero-kill missing-mana regen 20% -> 25%.
changes.meaning: The aggression-fueled mana minor pays out more — spam mages get their mana engine back after the 1.16 rework toned it down.

changes.name: Satariel
changes.change: Major: health reduction per Fearless stack 4%/6% -> 6.5%/7.5% (melee/ranged), bonus stats per stack 5% -> 4%. Risen omnivamp 12% -> 15%, Psychosis 3.5% +0.4% per level -> 3% +0.3%.
changes.meaning: The snowball gamble gets pricier and pays less per stack — but Risen hands back more omnivamp to survive it. Deep Satariel stacks are now a genuine all-in.

analysis.summary: Big all-around buff: more Physical Power per level, a faster/longer Evade, a much stronger Spear of Nyr (now with monster damage reduction and Magical scaling), and a bigger ult.
analysis.playing: He's stronger in lane and jungle — your spear pokes harder, you survive camps better, the ult does more, and Magical Power is now an option.
analysis.facing: Expect harder spear poke and a bigger ult; don't trade into his Evade and respect his improved survivability.
